prompt: How many countries were not listed as offering only paid access to YouTube Music at the time of its initial expansion in 2018?
answer: At the initial 2018 rollout, **South Korea was the only country listed as offering paid-only access**. Therefore, of the **17 countries** in the rollout, **16 countries were not listed as paid-only**.
